title: Community Garden Launch
subtitle: Project plan, budget and site files

ai.notes:
## Purpose

A plan to open a 12-bed community garden by spring. Readers are the volunteer committee.

## For the next AI

- Review and complete the **Budget** only. Use the attached budget.csv and site notes as sources.
- Keep the **Goal** exactly as written: the committee approved it.
- Keep entries short. Put open questions at the end of these notes.

work.objective: A complete, sourced budget the committee can approve.
work.instructions: Check each line against budget.csv. Add a contingency line and a total.
work.review: The project lead checks the totals before the committee meeting.

blocks.title: Goal
blocks.text: Open 12 raised beds to members by 1 May, within a $2,000 budget.

blocks.title: Summary
blocks.md: Two phases: **prepare the site**, then **build and open**. The water line is the main risk.

items.text: Confirm the lease with the landowner

blocks.title: 1. Confirm the lease
blocks.md: Signed for three years. A copy is with the treasurer.

blocks.title: 2. Mark out the beds
blocks.md: Twelve beds of 4 x 8 ft, with 3 ft paths. Keep the compost bins away from the east fence (see the site notes).

blocks.title: 3. Book the water line installer
blocks.md: Run from the north fence hookup. Ask for a quote that includes a backflow valve.
